mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When both unemployment rate decreases and payroll employment increases, it indicates a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE and PAYEMS improve but S&P 500 returns are not positive in majority cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which should boost S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases but S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests stronger supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate increased demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >50 units in 1 month
failure_condition: If HOUST increases but S&P 500 returns are not positive in majority cases.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation rises but federal funds rate does not increase, it may indicate a positive environment for equities, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases without corresponding FEDFUNDS increase but S&P 500 returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, low unemployment and high payroll employment indicate a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is low and PAYEMS is high but S&P 500 returns are not positive in majority cases.
